_doc: Duplicate-record merges (HANDOFF item 2). Each rule keeps one record and folds the `drop` records into it: the kept record's real-data cells win, the dropped records fill cells the kept one lacks, dropped names become compat aliases (taxonomy/system-aliases.json) and dropped ids redirect to the kept id (system-aliases.json `redirects`). `name` renames the kept record; `cells` overwrites cells on the kept record (subtractive edits that keep the existing citation). Apply with scripts/merge_records.py. `packages` replaces the kept record's taxonomy/package-aliases.json entry (used for the split).
